mapper.select: SELECT card_account_id, user_id, external_card_key, card_name,institution_id, connection_id, card_number_masked, payment_day, updated_at, issued_at, data_as_of_at FROM card_account WHERE external_card_key = #{externalCardKey}
mapper.update: UPDATE card_account SET user_id = #{userId}, institution_id = #{institutionId}, connection_id = #{connectionId}, card_name = #{cardName}, card_number_masked = #{cardNumberMasked}, payment_day = #{paymentDay}, updated_at = #{updatedAt}, issued_at = #{issuedAt}, data_as_of_at = #{dataAsOfAt} WHERE card_account_id = #{cardAccountId}
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO card_transaction ( card_account_id, external_transaction_id, transaction_at, amount, merchant_name ) VALUES
(#{t.cardAccountId}, #{t.externalTransactionId}, #{t.transactionAt}, #{t.amount}, #{t.merchantName})
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE transaction_at = VALUES(transaction_at), amount = VALUES(amount), merchant_name = VALUES(merchant_name)
